_comment: Runnable Priority programs and reports, for the run_program tool.
This file exists because Priority offers no way to enumerate them: APPS/APP
answer HTTP 404 and PROGDESIGN/FREPORTS are closed to the API. So this catalog
is the discovery surface — a program absent from here is invisible to the model,
and run_program refuses it because the server has no way to know its parameters
or what running it would do.
Seeded with the three reflection programs verified to exist in every Priority
installation. Add your own with a Hebrew description so the model can pick the
right one, and note in 'notes' anything a caller must know before running it.
type: 'R' = report (reads and renders), 'P' = procedure (can change data).
Be deliberate about adding a 'P': supplying its parameters is what makes it act.

programs.name: FORMTREE
programs.description: עץ מסכים — כל תתי-הטפסים של מסך, רקורסיבית, עם עומק וכותרת עברית
programs.notes: Takes 'Form Name'. Read-only. Returns Depth / Entity Name / Report Title / Type as a table, where the depth prefix (1, .2, ..3) shows nesting. Better than describe_screen for the shape of a screen's whole subtree: metadata navs show only one level at a time.

programs.name: FORMTRIGREP
programs.description: דוח טריגרים של מסך — מחזיר את כל הטריגרים ברמת המסך, כולל קוד מלא
programs.notes: Takes an internal form name, e.g. ORDERS. Read-only. The real content starts after the line 'Form Name ='.

programs.name: FORMCLTRIGREP
programs.description: דוח טריגרים ברמת עמודה — כל הטריגרים של עמודות המסך
programs.notes: Takes an internal form name. Read-only.

programs.name: FORMMSG
programs.description: מסרי מסך — כל ההודעות של מסך והמספרים התפוסים
programs.notes: Takes an internal form name. Present in every installation, which makes it the control when probing whether the program channel works at all.
